title: The Living Interval — One Connected Cosmology
scope: Gurdjieff's Ray of Creation and organic-life interval as recorded by P. D. Ouspensky; not a general cosmology or modern astrophysics

claims.content: Seven selected world orders with 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 48, 96 orders of laws
Planetary influences received by organic life and mediated to Earth
Different outgoing radiations to Sun, planets, Moon
The Moon's dependence or nourishment is not depicted by arrival of a moving mark

primary_sources.reference: P. D. Ouspensky, In Search of the Miraculous
primary_sources.sections: Ray of Creation, Law of Three, Law of Seven, and organic life

primary_sources.reference: Attributed Ouspensky organic-life excerpts, Gurdjieff Foundation Hawaii

relation_operations.on_screen: Permanent highlighted succession of seven named cosmic orders
relation_operations.semantic: Selection and precedence within a metaphysical model
relation_operations.not_asserted: A light beam transmitting energy, physical proximity, or sequential creation during the video

relation_operations.on_screen: Named source counts with a recurring motif of more constrained motion
relation_operations.semantic: Gurdjieff's greater mechanicalness in lower worlds
relation_operations.not_asserted: That each motif curve corresponds to an identified law; the counts are not measurements of laboratory rules

relation_operations.on_screen: Brief meeting of three labeled roles in the higher-world setting
relation_operations.semantic: Active, passive and neutralizing forces as relational roles
relation_operations.not_asserted: Three physical fluids, three permanently colored substances, or a specific astronomical mechanism

relation_operations.on_screen: Labeled pause between the planetary world and Earth
relation_operations.semantic: Special interval of descending cosmic octave described by the Law of Seven
relation_operations.not_asserted: An empty measurable space, absence of cosmic bodies, or the full theory of octaves

relation_operations.on_screen: Transient cyan/violet marks traveling from plural planetary representatives into living Earth
relation_operations.semantic: Planetary influences received by organic life
relation_operations.not_asserted: Particles, ray speeds, wavelengths, or exact cosmic sources

relation_operations.on_screen: Distinct trees, grasses, a deer and people that stay anchored to Earth's surface
relation_operations.semantic: Living intermediary and Earth’s sensitive organ of perception
relation_operations.not_asserted: A literal membranous organism or biome-wide physical antenna

relation_operations.on_screen: Life's receptive region brightens; different marks begin at the surface and travel inward
relation_operations.semantic: Mediation makes planetary influence receivable by Earth
relation_operations.not_asserted: A one-to-one physical transduction, conservation equation, or true biochemistry

relation_operations.on_screen: Three distinct families of moving symbols head from life to Sun, planetary sphere and Moon
relation_operations.not_asserted: Three physically identified substances or the Moon being maintained simply by arrival

relation_operations.on_screen: Continuous movement from overview to planets and living Earth then back out
relation_operations.semantic: Focus and reveal in a persistent model
relation_operations.not_asserted: Historical creation or extinction of worlds

retained_from_011: recognizable plants, animal and human gathering
retained_from_012: seven named and differentiated world orders
added_in_013: explicit statements of unspecified physical nature
integrated outgoing streams within the seven-world setting
not_claimed: complete exposition of the Law of Three/Seven
